meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: Claude 会查询 DepMap 数据库,获取癌症细胞系的 CRISPR 基因依赖评分、药物敏感性和基因效应数据,并做靶点验证、合成致死和生物标志物分析,返回依赖细胞系、p 值和共必需基因列表。
howto.when: 当你询问某基因在特定癌症中的必需性、某突变下的合成致死伙伴,或哪些特征预示药物敏感性时触发。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的依赖分数,列出依赖的细胞系。
在 BRCA1 突变的细胞系中,哪些基因是合成致死伙伴?
say.note: 会比较突变型与野生型细胞系的基因效应并做统计检验。

say.text: 找一下与 TP53 共必需的基因。
say.note: 按相关性返回头部共必需基因。

howto.what_en: Queries the DepMap database for CRISPR Chronos dependency scores, drug sensitivity, and gene effect profiles across cancer cell lines, enabling target validation, synthetic lethality, and biomarker analyses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about gene essentiality in cancer cell lines, synthetic lethal partners under a mutation, or cell-line features predicting drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Is KRAS essential in lung cancer cell lines? List the dependent lines.
say_en.note: Gets KRAS Chronos scores and filters by cancer type.

say_en.text: Which genes are synthetic lethal partners in BRCA1-mutant cell lines?
say_en.note: Compares gene effects between mutant and wild-type lines.
